confidence_notes: July lodging is estimated for peak season and has the widest uncertainty. City price data support the meal, cappuccino and 0.5 L draught beer estimates. The cocktail and house wine estimates use local prices relative to beer, with limited drink data as a check. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Faro), [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/price/cocktail/faro), [Bago drinks menu](https://bagowinebar.pt/menu/).
comparable_city_reasoning: Nearby Olhão and Tavira provide a regional benchmark for July lodging demand in the eastern Algarve.
